title: Northstar Mobility investigates battery complaints
text: Northstar Mobility said an independent engineering panel will investigate three battery complaints. The company published a safety update.

title: Regulator requests Northstar Mobility safety data
text: The Transport Standards Office requested safety data after reports of battery failure. No recall has been announced.

title: Northstar opens transparent battery testing lab
text: Northstar Mobility opened its testing process to University Engineering Lab researchers and published the results.
